pattern: \b(?:want(?:s)? to (?:kill|hurt) (?:myself|himself|herself)|think(?:ing)? about suicide|suicidal thoughts|self-harm|self harm|cutting myself|end(?:ing)? my life)\b
description: Keyword-phrase heuristic for family-mode response flagging. Family mode only (gated in code, not in this pattern) - never applies in personal mode, per CLAUDE.md's 'adult mode reports to no one' principle. Lower recall than structured PII by nature of keyword matching; a real ML classifier is Tier 3, not Phase 1.
Narrow set of explicit-content-request phrasings relevant to grooming/exploitation risk, not a general sexual-content classifier. Family mode only.
Direct-threat phrasings. Does not attempt to distinguish a real threat from quoting media/fiction (e.g. discussing a movie) - a known precision limitation for Phase 1. Family mode only.

pattern: \b(?:don'?t tell (?:your|my) (?:parents|mom|dad|mother|father)|keep (?:this|it) (?:a secret|between us)|our little secret|this stays between us)\b
description: Flags requests for secrecy that (in an AI chat, in family mode) may indicate manipulation or unsafe advice-seeking. Known false-positive risk: ordinary secret-keeping unrelated to safety (e.g. a surprise party) matches the same phrasing - see test-corpus/content-flags.jsonl. Family mode only.
